Pioneer preview: the next update

A quick look at the next update (version 0.53.1), as it appears in the Pioneer test build checked on 25 November 2026.

Read this first

Expected release: 2 December. This preview covers the Pioneer server update on 25 Nov 2026. Features and values may change before the live-server release on 2 Dec 2026. Other updates are already covered by Bacon in the Pioneer thread on the official Discord.
  • New Tatari: the Sharpup line (Sharpup, Scrawurst, Sketchund, Scribbadger), a Rock DPS that fights with pencils.
  • New mode: Whirling Wallop, a merge-and-defend mode with 11 named stages and element bonuses.
  • City of Gold pass with a Maple Mansion Pinball Machine skin.
  • Horde Invasion wording fixes and Zobo adjustments, plus Artifact Adventure invites.

New mode: Whirling Wallop

Drag and merge Tatari to defend the camp van, using contraptions on each map such as oil barrels you can smash open. Your Tatari’s weapons spin around them automatically and hit any Zobo that gets close. Stages must be cleared in order, can be replayed, and each stage’s reward can be claimed once.

Five families take part: Frostnip, Blueflick, Manteeny, Punchimp and Zapuni. Merging raises the tier: T1–T2 swing one blade, T3–T4 swing two, and damage per hit goes from 2 (T1) to 4 (T2–T3) to 6 (T4).

Whirling Wallop unlocks at Stage 3-80, with collection stages opening as you progress through the main story. The table lists the 30-Pinball collection reward, claimed once per listed stage. Mainline clear rewards are separate: Freezing Fronts lists 60 Pinballs; later stages list 30 Pinballs, 1 Star and 1 Shovel, with 30 Silver Bricks also listed from Desert Siege onward. Replays do not repeatedly award first-clear rewards.

City of Gold pass and Maple Mansion

A new pass called City of Gold (premium version: Sandy Pass) has 40 levels and four sets of weekly quests. Reaching level 40 requires 3,120 keys in total. After the final level, every 50 additional keys gives 10 Pinballs and 1,000 Candy.

Level 30 rewardTrack
Maple Pinballs (ball skin)Free
Pinball Machine Skin: Maple MansionPremium

Other levels mostly hand out Pinballs, Candy, Tatari Capsules, Tatari Scan Capsules, Bento and Tatari Wishboxes. Buying the premium pass mid-event unlocks the premium rewards for every level you have already reached. Maple Mansion and Maple Pinballs are permanent once unlocked. The extra 100 Pinball Tree storage lasts only while the pass benefit is active.

Horde Invasion adjustments

Many chip and skill descriptions are reworded. Most class and position chips now say “HP” instead of “Max HP”, and the level-up chip now states that only one Tatari is upgraded. Banana Bash no longer says “periodically”.

ZoboChange in this build
Volcano ZoboDeath explosion damage 120% → 90% ATK; rebirth HP ratio 45% → 40%
Sailor ZoboBarrel damage 50% → 40% ATK; barrel HP growth lowered
Laser ZoboCharged lightning damage 25% → 20% ATK
Pharaoh ZoboLaser stops after up to 10 hits and uses a 3s cooldown. Death-curse Fragile lasts 1.5s instead of 4s.
Garden ZoboVine damage and vine stun now end after 10 s instead of lasting indefinitely
Shaman ZoboIts debuff can no longer be cleansed
Hydro ZoboIts weakening debuff can no longer be cleansed
The game can now switch itself to Low Performance Mode when the connection is unstable or the frame rate drops.
  • Barricade chip: Tatari in your front two rows gain 40% HP and DEF, but deal 10% less damage. It now rechecks who qualifies every 4 seconds, as well as reacting to movement. Those stat modifiers have not changed.
  • Roll of Fate chip: checks unique-chip ownership before choosing its random chip.
  • Make Wave chip and Gorilla’s skill have effect-positioning and layering fixes; these are separate from their skill stat values.

Artifact Adventure

  • New Adventure Invite: you can notify offline friends that you’re playing Artifact Adventure. They need notifications turned on to receive it.
  • Visual effects are reworked for the deeper levels.
  • The official notes add that Rule of Threes and similar buffs now also apply to artifacts dropped by Zobos — need to verify in-game.
